title: Phase 3 Focus: Neural State XP, aura, Monk Mode, bio-rhythm
area: Mind side (repo root C:\Ossa\ossa-expo): Neural State XP, focus_aura, monk_mode_setup, focus_timer_stance, monk_mode_completion, bio_rhythm_sync, and the Breathe vs Focus tab name

keyFacts.fact: Breathing patterns are a table: Longer exhale 4-6, Box 4-4-4-4, 4-7-8. Even breath 5.5/5.5 is added later. The Breathe UI lists Even, Box, Longer exhale and 4-7-8, plus Calm sessions Float, Deep calm and Sleep drift. Lengths are 1/2/3/5/10 min and sounds are Chime/Tidal/Silent.

A finished breathing session logs only {d, k:"breath", min}, and only if it ran at least 0.5 min. The technique, timestamp, planned length and whether you finished are not stored. Calm sessions log the same shape.
The breath log is read by mindWeek (minutes this week), the Mind home 'This week', the heart system card, and the 'breathe' standard, which ticks itself.

A focus timer already exists: Mind › Focus session with 15/25/50 chips and Pause/End. It lives only in memory as MIND.focus={dur,start,paused,pAt}. The time is worked out from Date.now(), so a backgrounded app catches up, but a WebView reload loses the session. It logs {d,k:"focus",min} (≥1 min) and ends with a toast. There's no notification.
keyFacts.ref: web/ossa.html:8524-8553 (mindFocus, focusLeft, focusTick, endFocus); App.js:169-170 (reload on content-process termination)

keyFacts.fact: The Breathe tab opens the Mind screen straight on the breathing tool (MIND.next="breath"). '‹ Mind' leads to the full Mind home. uiCurTab reports "breathe" while MIND.open.

The Mind panel is opaque (radial-gradient background, z-index 7). The 3D head zoom only plays as a transition behind it. The Mind home draws an SVG brain, so today the 3D head isn't visible on the Mind screen.

The Mind pillar of the Body Score is the average of the check-in's focus, mood, energy and inverted stress. The one-tap check-in fills only energy and mood (both set to 'feel'), so Mind = how you said you feel. Breathing and focus sessions don't feed it, except through protocol standard bonuses.

Ossa DOES have XP today, in Learn: S.learn={xp,done,days}, level thresholds RD_LV, rdLevel, rdAward, a learning streak, and a daily goal of 10 XP. It shows on the Learn page as 'Level N' and 'total XP'. The daily body fact awards '+5 XP'. DECISIONS.md says 'Ossa has no XP system', which is inaccurate.

Reminders are web-driven. remindPlan() builds the whole list. save() triggers nativeSoon(), which sends {t:"remind",list} after 1.6 s (60 ms when asking permission). Native cancels ALL pending notifications and reschedules the list (up to 60). So a Monk Mode end notification can be added with no native change, and ending early removes it on the next sync.
Notifications show as banners even while Ossa is open, and play no sound in the foreground. Scheduled content sets no sound field (whether that means silent by default is unconfirmed).
A tapped notification sends {t:"open",go}, handled by nativeOpen. Unknown 'go' values fall back to the Body tab. On return to the foreground App.js sends {t:"fg"}.

The web can only open https: and mailto: links through the bridge. App-Prefs:, shortcuts:// and the Focus settings can't be opened without changing App.js, which needs a new build. App-Prefs: URLs are private API (App Review guideline 2.5.1 risk) and should not be used.

Haptics bridge: navigator.vibrate is posted to native buzz(). An array longer than 1 plays the single 'Success' notification haptic, not a pattern. A total ≤6 plays selection, ≤10 a Light impact, anything more a Medium impact. A lub-dub is possible from the web as two timed calls (e.g. 14 then 9 ms → Medium then Light), with no build.

Apple Health reads StepCount, SleepAnalysis and RestingHeartRate only. rhr is the mean of up to 7 resting-HR samples from the last 7 days. It's saved to S.health.rhr and S.bpm. No HeartRate or HRV is read. Any change to native/health.ios.js or the permission strings needs a new EAS build (no expo-updates).

The camera permission text still promises it. A second, manual source exists: the body check's 'Resting heart rate' test (count for 30 s, or use the Apple Health value), stored in S.bchecks.

keyFacts.fact: The 3D heart beats at a fixed ~72 bpm outside onboarding. In the onboarding/breathing scene (Body.obStart/obSet), every Body.obBeat() plays a lub-dub envelope (0.21 s apart). The Calm breathing session already uses this scene and beats at S.bpm||68.

The body has a rig and a pose table: MOVES holds joint rotations (thigh, shin, foot, upper arm, forearm, spine, pelvis, root, head), played by Body.startDemo({move,period,view,mask}). leg_ext is already a seated-type pose and lessons blend poses (rdSetPose). A seated 'monk_sit' could be one more MOVES entry; whether the mesh deforms well is the mesh agent's question.

There's no head aura today. Body.setAura only tints the background with a colour wash. The organ shader has a raymarched brain at the head, but it's forced off (uBrain=0). A separate WebGL canvas with its own shader is an established pattern (rdAlienMake, used by Calm).
openSystem("heart") already frames our own heart and lungs on the 3D body (core layer, camera on the chest). Its card shows 'bpm resting' and breathing minutes.
The name 'Monk Mode Lite' is already taken: a 21-day programme listed as 'Coming soon' in Programmes.

web/ui files are pulled in with include markers (CSS at 3345-3353, JS at 11873-11878), then boot runs and uiBoot() is called last. A new focus.js, aura.js and focus.css each need one marker line in ossa.html.
web/, native/ and docs/ are untracked in git (one 'Initial commit'). Past safety nets were folder backups.
Analytics (Mixpanel track()) exists but is off (MP_TOKEN=""). If it's turned on later, new events must not carry the task text or heart rate.

items.name: Neural State XP (system)
items.today: No focus/breathing XP. The mind log stores {d,k,min} only (web/ossa.html:8550, :8635, :11772). A separate Learn XP exists (S.learn, rdAward at :10617, RD_LV at :10610). DECISIONS.md:89 wrongly says Ossa has no XP.

changes.change: Rules: breathing earns 2 XP a minute, +2 for finishing the length you picked, capped at 30 XP a day. Monk Mode earns 1 XP a minute (counts from 5 min), +2 × planned minutes for finishing (25→75, 50→150, 90→270), capped at 400 XP a day. nxXpFor(entry) and nxAward(entry) write xp onto the log entry itself. nxTotal() = sum of log xp. nxLevel(xp): the step to the next level costs 60+20×L (L2 at 80, L5 440, L10 1,440, L15 2,940, L20 4,940). nxStage(lv): Dormant 1, Spark 2-4, Facets 5-9, Crown 10-14, Crystalline 15-19, Lattice 20+. nxCharge(): last session today 100%, 1-2 days 70%, 3-6 days 45%, 7+ days 25%. Levels never drop. nxMigrate() runs once: it backfills minute-only XP on old entries and sets the level as already seen, so there's no surprise celebration. When S.demo is on it seeds about 14 days of sessions so previews show a mid-level aura.

changes.file: web/ossa.html:8635 and :11772 (in place, one line each)
changes.change: Push richer entries {d,k,min,at,pat,plan,full}, then call nxAward on the new entry if it's defined. This is a small in-place edit: the Calm finish is a closure, so a wrapper can't reach it.

Old readers (mindWeek, the 'breathe' standard) keep working.
S.neural = {v:1 (migration done), lv:int (highest level reached, never drops), seenLv:int (last level celebrated)}. Total XP is derived as the sum of S.mind.log[].xp, not stored separately.

items.name: Crystalline aura renderer (system)
items.today: No head effect. Body.setAura is a background wash (web/ossa.html:4097-4101, :4888). The brain object in the organ shader is forced off (:4139, :4615). A separate-canvas shader precedent exists (rdAlienMake, :11592).

changes.change: Aura.mount(host), Aura.set({lv,charge,mode:'full'|'subtle'}), Aura.stop(). A small WebGL canvas with its own fragment shader: a halo, then crystal shards whose count, length and arcs grow with nxStage, then a wireframe lattice at Lattice. Every frame while visible it's placed over the head with Body.project([0,1.66,0]) and a projected head radius, so it follows the camera tween. Colours come from tokens via fxTok('--neural'). Reduced motion shows one still frame. It pauses when document.hidden, frees its context on stop (like RDAlienO.stop), and falls back to 2D canvas without WebGL.
Add /*@include ui/aura.js*/ before focus.js, after train.js (line 11878).
Needs --neural (brief: #00E5FF) and --neural-a, likely from the Phase 0 Look pass. Add them here if that pass hasn't.

risks: A second WebGL context costs memory and battery on iPhone. Only one aura canvas at a time, destroyed when hidden.
It's an overlay, so the head doesn't hide the shards. Keep shards around the silhouette, never across the face.
The agent restyling the body shader (rank colours, red pulse, wireframe) could clash. A separate canvas avoids touching makeGLBody.
Phones without WebGL get the flat figure: the aura draws around a simple head outline.
Precise placement depends on the head-zoom camera (headZoom zoom 5.2, py 0.78, web/ossa.html:4850-4854).
designDeviations: The design's head render is replaced by our own 3D head. The aura is drawn around it and grows by stage, never replacing the model (ground rule 1).

items.name: focus_timer_stance (with the Monk Mode timer engine)
items.today: MIND.focus is in memory only (web/ossa.html:8533). Time comes from Date.now() (:8544), with a 500 ms interval (:8546) and only a toast at the end (:8551). The session is lost if the WebView reloads (App.js:169-170). No end notification. App.js already sends 'fg' on resume (App.js:138-140).

changes.change: Engine. monkStart() saves S.monk.run={start,end,plan,task,quiet}, with no pause. monkLeft()=end−now. A 1 s ticker runs only while visible, and time is recomputed on visibilitychange, on 'fg' (wrap nrecv) and at boot (wrap uiBoot). Running → reopen the timer. Ended while away → finish as complete with minutes=plan. End session needs two taps, like the workout's Finish. monkEnd(full) logs {k:'focus',min,plan,full,at,task} and calls nxAward, then nativeSync(true) to bypass the 1.6 s wait and cancel the pending notification.

Wrap remindPlan() (web/ossa.html:10279). While a run exists, add {at:end+2000, go:'monk', title:'Monk Mode done', body:'50 minutes. Come back for your XP.'}. If run.quiet, drop Ossa's own nudges and desk resets that fall between start and end. Wrap nativeOpen(go) (:10106) so go:'monk' opens the completion or the running timer.
Wrap goBack (web/ossa.html:8019) and closePanels (already wrapped in ranks.js; wrap again) so back and tab taps leave the session running.
Show a live dot on the Focus tab while S.monk.run is active, like Train's live workout dot.

Stance. If MOVES.monk_sit exists (mesh agent), Body.startDemo({move:'monk_sit',period:5.5,view:0,mask:[]}) with the camera framing between the timer and the tiles. Otherwise the standing glassy scene, cropped waist-up (camTo zoom ~1.6) so the chest glow is centred, with Body.breathe(true,lv) on a slow 5.5 s cycle and the aura at the head. Everything is restored on exit (stopDemo, breathe(false), obEnd).
Hero timer (Archivo, --fs-7 or larger, tabular numbers), status pill, two glass tiles, the quiet-nudges row, and a bone End session button.

items.name: bio_rhythm_sync
items.today: Haptics map to selection/light/medium/success only (App.js:24-31). Resting HR is already read (native/health.ios.js:45, :93-94) into S.health.rhr and S.bpm (web/ossa.html:10357). changes.change: bioOpen() shows a screen over the body: Body.obStart and obSet with glass, org, heart and lungs, then Body.obView('heart') to frame the chest. bioBeat() loops at 60000/tempo ms: Body.obBeat(), Pulse.buzz(14) (Medium), and Pulse.buzz(9) 210 ms later (Light), matching the visual lub-dub. It stops on document.hidden, on leaving, and when switched off. The tempo is a game rule: base = S.health.rhr, else the body-check bpm, else 60, clamped to 48-80, times (1 + 0.15 × the share of GLORDER muscles where stateOf()==='recovering', web/ossa.html:3901). The state word is Settled (none recovering), Steady (<30%) or Rebuilding, with '18 of 23 muscles ready'. 'Breathe with it · 2 min' runs Even breath 5.5/5.5 while the beat eases back to base, and logs a breath session that earns XP.
Entry points: the Neural State 'Heartbeat' row; a 'Feel the rhythm' button on the heart system card (wrap renderSys, web/ossa.html:9172); a row on the Recover tab (web/ui/shell.js ~540-559).

openQuestions.question: Rename the third tab from Breathe to Focus?
openQuestions.why: The design and the brief's core loop (Train / Focus / Recover) say Focus. Monk Mode is the headline of that tab, and breathing moves one tap in.
openQuestions.recommendation: Focus. Keep the internal key 'breathe' so nothing else churns.

openQuestions.question: One XP or two? Learn already has XP and levels (S.learn).
openQuestions.why: The aura level and the Learn level side by side could confuse people. DECISIONS.md also says Ossa has no XP, which is wrong.
options: Separate: Aura XP from focus and breathing only; rename Learn's to 'Learn level'
Merge into one Ossa XP that feeds the aura
openQuestions.recommendation: Separate for now, as the brief says (focus and breathing grow the aura). Rename Learn's label to 'Learn level'.

openQuestions.question: Approve the XP numbers?
openQuestions.why: They set the pace of the whole Neural State. The proposal matches the design's +12 and +150.
options: Breathing 2 XP/min +2 for finishing (30/day cap). Monk Mode 1 XP/min + 2× planned minutes for finishing (400/day cap). Next level costs 60+20×level.
openQuestions.recommendation: The first option: level 2 on day one, level 15 in about 5 weeks of one 25-minute session and one breath a day.

openQuestions.question: What unlocks at level 15 ('Zen Flow')?
openQuestions.why: Locking a breathing tool behind a level takes away something free today.
options: A cosmetic aura stage or colour
openQuestions.recommendation: Cosmetic only: the Crystalline aura stage.

openQuestions.question: What should Monk Mode completion list under 'what you logged'?
openQuestions.why: The design lists lifts with RP, which a focus session doesn't log.
options: 'Today so far': this session, breathing, today's workout, water (real logs)
Only this session and its task
openQuestions.recommendation: 'Today so far', from real logs, plus the task you named.

openQuestions.question: The timer's streak tile: which streak?
openQuestions.why: Ossa already has the plan streak (uiStreak) and a Learn streak. A third would be noise.
options: No streak: show 'Focus today: N min'
openQuestions.recommendation: 'Focus today: N min' and the aura level.

openQuestions.question: 'Monk Mode Lite' (a 21-day programme marked Coming soon) clashes with the Monk Mode timer.
openQuestions.why: Two things with nearly the same name in different places.
options: Build it later around daily Monk Mode sessions
openQuestions.recommendation: Remove it from Coming soon now. Revisit as a programme later.

openQuestions.question: Can a Monk Mode session be paused?
openQuestions.why: The design has End only. The old focus timer had Pause.
options: No pause; ending early keeps the minutes
openQuestions.recommendation: No pause. It keeps the notification simple and the rule honest.

openQuestions.question: Should the haptic heartbeat start by itself when the screen opens?
openQuestions.why: Unexpected vibration surprises people, and it uses battery.
options: Tap to start, then remember the choice
openQuestions.recommendation: Tap to start, remembered in S.mind.ui.beat.

openQuestions.question: Bring back the camera fingertip pulse reading on the heartbeat screen?
openQuestions.why: The code exists but is unused. Torch support inside the iOS WebView is unconfirmed, and readings can be poor.
options: Not in v1: Apple Health plus the body-check count
Test on a device, then add it as 'Read my pulse (estimate)'
openQuestions.recommendation: Not in v1. Revisit after a device test. Either way, update the camera permission text if it stays unused.

openQuestions.question: Show the aura on the Body page too?
openQuestions.why: The brief says the actions evolve the character, but the Body page was deliberately kept a still figure.
options: Subtle halo on the Body page from level 2, full on Focus
openQuestions.recommendation: A subtle, still halo on the Body page; the full animated aura only on Focus.

openQuestions.question: Put the optional native extras in the next EAS build?
openQuestions.why: A sound on the 'Monk Mode done' notification and a shortcuts:// button for setting up a Focus both need App.js or native changes.
options: Batch them into the one build before Ship
openQuestions.recommendation: Batch the notification sound. Skip shortcuts:// unless testers ask.

orderNotes:
This whole area is web-only (web/ui/focus.js, aura.js, focus.css, a few lines in shell.js, two one-line edits plus include markers in web/ossa.html). It can be tested in the preview and in Expo Go with no EAS build. Order:
(1) Build after the Phase 0 Look pass, so the screens use the new tokens (--neural cyan, Inter, glass) once instead of being restyled twice.
(2) Within the Focus phase: Neural XP data and migration → aura renderer → focus_aura with the tab rename → Monk Mode engine, setup and timer (standing) → completion → bio-rhythm.
(3) The seated pose slots in when the mesh agent delivers a MOVES.monk_sit entry; the timer ships standing without it.
(4) Bio-rhythm reads the shared stateOf(). If the Vessel Engine phase changes fading or pauses fades for injuries, use the same function so the heartbeat never disagrees with the body.
(5) Coordinate with whoever edits the body shader (rank colours, red pulse, wireframe). The aura is deliberately a separate canvas to avoid conflicts.
(6) Store copy, review notes and screenshots mentioning Breathe are updated in the Ship phase.
(7) Optional native extras (notification sound) go in the single build before Ship.
Safety: web/, native/ and docs/ are untracked in git. Before starting, take a folder backup like the earlier ones, or make a commit if Andrej approves.
